status: Comparison architecture fixed; human annotation rubric awaiting 16-item calibration. Not preregistration or permission to generate.
question: In a fixed local PSYCHE-style prompt port, does an operational thought-transition instruction increase evidence-backed unclear transitions beyond a category label, after accounting for its effect under Normal, and what happens to question answering and supplied facts?
scope: Instruction-module experiment using a third-party PSYCHE-style implementation, not native PSYCHE efficacy or a clinical symptom score

conditions.name: neutral
conditions.rule: Omit Thought process and Experimental thought-process instruction; preserve all other profile and output fields

conditions.name: coherent_multitopic
conditions.rule: Same as neutral with benign instruction
conditions.instruction: Discuss several aspects of the requested activity, keeping the transitions understandable through ordinary temporal, causal, or elaborative connections. Keep answering the question. Do not name this instruction.

operational_instructions_policy: Reuse the two verbatim researcher-authored instructions in psyche-thought-v01; source-informed paraphrases, not original PSYCHE prompts. Export hashes before generation.
fixed_factors: same seed within a comparison block; paired seed is not guaranteed shared randomness
primary_endpoint: Single human reviewer: at least one interpretable clause/sentence transition with an unclear or oblique connection, backed by ordered verbatim evidence spans and a reason; yes/no/uncertain/unassessable
primary_estimand: (C4-C3)-(C2-C1) in response-level transition-presence proportion, first averaged across question/seed blocks per fictional case, then equally across cases
primary_bound: Unknown ratings are not zero. Compute full-denominator binary bounds for each cell; contrast lower bound L4-U3-U2+L1 and upper U4-L3-L2+U1. Missing outputs likewise remain unknown. No threshold chosen after holdout.
secondary: supplied-fact present/contradicted/absent/uncertain with quote; claim presence alone is not correctness
word/sentence counts and pairwise length mismatch
metric_audit_only: existing OS sentence embedding 512D revision1 question-answer cosine
topic prototype association only if fixed before outcomes; never mislabeled as actual-question cosine
adjacent cosine and adjacency excess; not success criteria
MATTR and repetition as confound descriptors

human_review.qualification: medical student researcher; not clinical gold
human_review.blinding: hide condition/model/arm and metric results; preserve original question/text; content recognition remains possible
human_review.calibration_rule: Review all 16; fix ambiguous rules with version log and verify quotes before any confirmatory generation. Do not optimize rubric to separate intended labels.
human_review.no_rater_fallback: If transition annotation remains infeasible, narrow to question-answer/fact preservation after an explicit design amendment; do not replace human criterion with cosine or unvalidated Qwen judge.

confirmation_plan.case_and_question_manifest_status: not yet authored/frozen; required before release
confirmation_plan.old_32_holdout_requests: untouched; not automatically released or called equivalent to the new design
confirmation_plan.analysis: case-level effects plus all blocks; no p-values treating seeds or sentences as patients

decision_rule: Report estimated interaction and unknown-value bounds, control flags, and side effects. Directionally consistent candidate only if interaction lower bound >0 overall and positive point estimates in at least 3/4 cases; operational study rule, not clinical threshold or powered efficacy test. Any worsened within-clause intelligibility, answering or factual contradiction is reported separately and prevents an unqualified improvement claim.
repair_policy: Only one demonstrated evaluable failure may trigger stage4; changes freeze before stage5. If no repair is justified, stage5 confirms the original comparison. Holdout is never used to choose a repair.
stage3_release_requirements: calibration completed and rubric version fixed
literal prompts and input manifests frozen
model/template/options match or reuse analyzed separately
explicit bounded generation decision; no paid API/model install
fact inventory and evidence scoring rules fixed before inspecting newly generated outputs
stop_this_turn: Produce evidence audit, one-page design and blank blinded calibration packet. No new speech, embedding or clinical annotation.
primary_point_estimate_policy: Within each case, use only question/seed blocks with definite yes/no in all C1-C4 for the point interaction. Report joint-complete blocks and all-block unknown-value bounds separately. Zero joint-complete blocks gives null case point estimate and cannot satisfy directional-consistency criterion; do not silently reweight across different available cells.
